versions.subject: rule: Suspicious IIS module installation
versions.detection:
selection_1:
   CommandLine|contains: 'appcmd.exe add module'
   ParentImage|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
selection_2:
   CommandLine|contains: ' system.enterpriseservices.internal.publish'
   ParentImage|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
   Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
selection_3:
   CommandLine|contains: ' \\gacutil.exe /I'
   ParentImage|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
condition: 1 of selection*
versions.spl: (CommandLine="*appcmd.exe add module*" ParentImage="*\\w3wp.exe") OR (CommandLine="* system.enterpriseservices.internal.publish*" ParentImage="*\\w3wp.exe" Image="*\\powershell.exe") OR (CommandLine="* \\gacutil.exe /I*" ParentImage="*\\w3wp.exe")
